placements.title: The team reflects on its sprints in a format of its own making, not the generic one it used before
placements.frame: What format does the engineering team use to look back on a sprint, what is it replacing, and what does the change say about how the team wants to reflect?
placements.why: RetroFormatAdoption holds the adoption of the Velociraptor format, its three sections (Sailed, Stalled, Capsized), and its replacement of start-stop-continue. The subject, how the team runs its retrospectives, is one future envelopes will keep feeding. The only existing leaf concerns the analytics database decision and does not hold it, so this stands as a new leaf with no parent.

mints.name: TeamProcess
mints.title: How the engineering team runs its own process, including its sprint retrospectives
mints.why: The envelope is titled Team Process. Retro format is the first piece of team-process content in the graph, and the existing DatabaseDecision stratum does not hold it. Future rituals and process changes will connect here.

connections.why: The leaf is about the team's retrospective practice, which is team process.
The position records a change to a team ritual, the retro format.
